title: Observability Without the Invoice: An SRE's Open Source APM Experiment
excerpt: Built a full open-source observability stack — Grafana Alloy, Beyla, Tempo, Mimir, Loki, Pyroscope, Faro, and Cilium/Hubble — as an alternative to Dynatrace/Datadog. Covers what it replaces, where it falls short, and the operational trade-offs.
